# Installing a cluster on Alibaba Cloud by using the Assisted Installer {#installing-alibaba-assisted-installer}

You can install an OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ alibaba }} using the {{ ai_full }}.

{{ alibaba }} provides a broad range of cloud computing and data storage services to online businesses and global enterprises.
